items.title: Google EmbeddingGemma 2
items.source_text: Google EmbeddingGemma 2 An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68. Artificial Intelligence Audio Video
